planning_basis: Approximately 5.9 million raw proteins and billions of coding bases; compressed CDS storage plus headers and two active temporary downloads. Exact publisher sizes vary; 50 GB is a conservative allowance, not measured size.
memory_policy: Stream compressed downloads and one CDS record at a time; retain record IDs per taxon for uniqueness checks. Two workers.
cost: Public NCBI files and existing authorized host; no new charges
purpose: Assembly-matched coding sequence acquisition for later translation, codon alignment and selection feasibility checks; acquisition alone does not establish suitability.
